excerpts: The Axure MCP server lets you give any MCP-compatible AI tool access to content from your whiteboard and document files on Axure Cloud. Once set up, you can share links to your designs in a prompt and the AI tool will be able to read and interpret the content, using your Axure files as context for code generation, analysis, and more. citations.title: Company - Axure
excerpts: In 2002, we were working for a start-up in the Bay Area, and found ourselves repeatedly frustrated by limitations of the typical software development life cycle: product and design teams had difficulty evaluating their solutions before writing specifications, and developers didn't understand (or read) the specifications they were given. The results ranged from inefficiency to compromised products. Having worked as project managers and developers, we knew both sides of the experience—we lived the pain. We started Axure to discover how to make software projects better. While others were coming up with extreme new approaches to shift responsibility in the development process, we believed that better tools enabling user experience design was the answer. We decided to create a simple tool that would allow non-programmers to build interactive prototypes with documentation.

[Axure RP](https://www.axure.com/changelog?filter=Axure+RP)

[Axure RP 11.0.0.4150 for Windows](https://axure.cachefly.net/versions/11-0/AxureRP-Setup-4150.exe) [Axure RP 11.0.0.4150 for Mac (ARM)](https://axure.cachefly.net/versions/11-0/AxureRP-Setup-arm64-4150.dmg) [Axure RP 11.0.0.4150 for Mac (Intel)](https://axure.cachefly.net/versions/11-0/AxureRP-Setup-4150.dmg)
### [Axure RP MCP, Windows Snap, and faster Mac rendering](https://www.axure.com/changelog/2026-09-24)
### Axure RP MCP (Machine Context Protocol) (alpha)
MCP

You can now run a built-in **MCP server** from Axure RP to give AI agents and tools access to the pages, widgets, interactions, and notes in your RP files. The AI can use your designs for code generation, analysis, documentation, and more.

The Axure RP MCP server is run locally from Axure RP (different than the Axure Cloud MCP server) and lets you connect to tools including [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) , [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) , and [Cursor](https://cursor.com/) . Once connected, you can ask it to use the context in your open files in plain language like "Generate React components that match the layout on this page."
Learn more about setting up and using the MCP server in this article [Using Axure RP with AI tools via MCP](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/mcp/) .
MCP is currently experimental and we'd love your feedback. Please send messages from RP or email us at [support@axure.com](mailto:support@axure.com) .
### Windows Snap flyout

Windows Snap lets you quickly arrange and resize application windows on a PC. A customer recently [pointed out](https://forum.axure.com/t/windows-snap-feature-in-axure-rp-11-does-not-work/78765/2) that the [Windows Snap flyout](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/snap-your-windows#:~:text=different%20predetermined%20layouts.-,Snap%20flyout,-The%20Snap%20flyout) was not working in Axure RP. Now, the Snap flyout appears when you hover over the maximize button on an Axure RP window and lets you choose a layout.
### Faster rendering on Macs

Several optimizations were made to the rendering engine to make Axure RP 11 faster on Macs. The improvements are most noticeable when working on pages with many widgets. Everything from editing widget properties to scrolling is now much faster.

basis.reasoning: The changelog's September 24, 2026 entry announces Axure RP MCP and Windows Snap and describes faster Mac rendering, all new product/feature changes within the six months before November 9, 2026.
